highlights.title: Drop audio files into a chat
highlights.text: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG and FLAC files up to 100 MB now go into a chat, so a bot can upload a song or a recording on a page for you.

highlights.title: Tidier reply buttons on a phone
highlights.text: On a phone, Reply, 👍, 👎 and Copy sit on one row, result buttons get their own row, the empty gap under a reply is gone, and the Ask: row shows a small dot when a bot needs you.

highlights.title: Your deploy is never stuck behind Deny
highlights.text: When kwant can't tell whether a production deploy changes the database, the card lets you set a backup command right there, or allow it without a backup once you confirm it doesn't.

fixes: A team named like "Marketing_Team" or "SalesTeam" reads "@Marketing_Team", never "… team team".
The bot browser's live preview no longer flashes white or grey while a page loads; it keeps the last picture until the new page shows.
A done, skipped or timed-out browser step card no longer says the bot needs you; it reads "<name> asked for you in the browser" in grey.
A customer's refused call now remembers the chat it happened in, so it can show in that customer's chat.
A bot whose step keeps failing stops once with a Blocked card naming the step and its error, instead of repeating itself.
